summary: Targeted independent source audit of the deterministic chronology defects in Jinshu 127: the three cited historical attestations have reversed Western intervals, from AD 350 to AD 322. The Chinese passages identify historical episodes but do not themselves license a shared AD 350–322 activity interval. The affected records require a separately sourced repair and a fresh complete audit; this report does not approve the chapter or infer replacement dates.
